opening.argument: The video presents a focused medical discussion of slipped-disc causes and treatment options, covering both conservative care and surgery. Its description expressly states that treatments range from “conservative to surgical,” while the discussion addresses when surgery may be required and identifies physiotherapy, medicines, and precautions as possible approaches. It also explains that surgery may involve a “small incision” known as minimally invasive or keyhole surgery. Presented by a person identified as a neurosurgery and spine-surgery consultant, the medical video-consultation link is contextually consistent with the healthcare subject, not evidence of deceptive solicitation. Transcription errors and the absence of independent verification do not establish deceptive conduct.
